name: Memory of Love (3pp)
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 min.
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A memory of a loved one (mother, spouse, etc.) overwhelms the target every time he looks at you, preventing him from physically harming you. His feelings are directed only toward you – not your companions. The spell’s effect is broken if you attack the target. The target receives a new Will save every round to shake off the spell’s effects.
